White Whale or Beluga Whale (Delphinapterus leucas) from Churchill River near Hudson Bay (Canada)
Two Beluga whale swimming underwater in a marine sanctuary near the Westman Islands, Iceland. The beluga whale is a small Arctic cetacean known for its white coloration and rounded forehead (melon).
